integrity: An analytic proof is supplied; a standalone diagnostic checker is not an infinite certificate. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: The compact absorbing radii are sufficient, not optimal.
The theorem classifies global boundedness and global attraction, not local attractor basins, periodic orbits, chaos or invariant measures.
All conclusions concern the deterministic real-plane dynamics; finite-precision output clipping and externally forced noise are excluded.
Only inspected accessible literature is compared; an unindexed generic dissipativity theorem could contain the criterion.
title: A sharp global-attractor threshold for the two-cell sigmoid spiking map
